text:
Roberta Zuliani I think these things take longer? The author said that they are already waiting for the next ceremony date, and that while waiting they got the job abroad. But does that mean they move immediately? I would think there is some time to make arrangements before moving abroad for 1.5 years... 
Anyway, I think the ceremony could be sooner than they think, definitely not months away (as they put it in the post) and I would advise to inquire about it and ask to schedule it, rather than just wait...
